evals.prompt: 为仓储团队生成一个名为 inventory-console 的 qiankun 子应用。需要商品和库存列表、多条件筛选、库存详情、调整库存抽屉、批量盘点；仓库管理员可编辑，审计员只读。使用 Mock，但提供可替换 API。
evals.expected_output: A buildable Umi Max data-management app with qiankun slave, feature modules, Mock and RBAC.
expectations: yarn build exits with code 0
.umirc.ts enables qiankun.slave and antd
src/app.ts exports qiankun bootstrap, mount, and unmount
routes live in src/router/routes.ts and access flags in src/access.ts
pages assemble features and do not import mock/
loading, empty, error, and forbidden states are implemented
README documents host integration and API replacement points
